verdict.rationale: Chronicle documents programmatic automation through SDKs in five languages and a REST API, and its authentication docs name a CI key, which points to headless and CI use. Idempotent retries after timeouts or crashes also suit unattended pipelines. However, no evidence shows an end-to-end CI workflow such as triggering evaluation runs or gating on pass thresholds from CI. Missing for 10: a documented CLI or CI integration guide (e.g. a GitHub Action), explicit headless triggering of evaluation runs with pass/fail exit status, and independent hands-on corroboration.
